newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe Telecom sets terms on stock rights.
newsitem.headline: Globe Telecom sets terms on stock rights.

text.p: Globe Telecom said on Tuesday its board of directors has set the terms of its 1.6 billion-peso stock rights offer which it approved in August.
Shareholders will be able to buy, at 12.0 pesos, one new share for every 4.470503831 outstanding shares of record as of October 21, 1996, the company said in a statement.
The share offer shall consist of 133.33 million shares, broken down into 81.1 million Class A shares and 52.23 million Class B shares.
Globe Telecom is an affiliate of Ayala Corp.
